title: The Swordmaster's Youngest Son
altTitles: Reincarnation of the Swordmaster's Youngest Son
The Youngest Son of a Renowned Family of Swordsmen
The Youngest Son of a Master Swordsman
Youngest Son of the Renowned Swordsmanship Clan
description: Jin Runcandel is the youngest son of the Runcandel family, the world's greatest clan of swordmasters. Despite his prestigious birth, Jin is considered the biggest failure in the family's history and is eventually cast out. After meeting a tragic end, he is given another chance at life and awakens with the memories of his previous life, extraordinary talent, and a contract with a mysterious god. Determined to make full use of his second chance, Jin begins his journey to become the greatest swordmaster.
author: Emperor Penguin
